sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

This matter is listed on Office Note dated 09.11.2023 wherein, inadvertently, FIR No. is mentioned as 279/2022 instead of FIR No.297/2022 in paragraph 11 of order dated 30.10.2023.
2.

In view thereof, paragraph 11 of the said earlier order dated 30.10.2023 is substituted and henceforth be read as under:-
" 11.

Accordingly, the petition is allowed and FIR No. 297/2022 dated 28.03.2022 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Jyoti Nagar, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed."
3. Needless to mention that the order dated 30.10.2023 and the present order shall be read conjointly.
4. The Office Note is accordingly discharged.
